competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove 1 beneficial effect with a 35% chance and provoke for 1 turn with a 35% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times. The first hit grants Irresistible for 2 turns with a 50% chance, and the second hit stuns for 1 turn with a 50% chance. The damage of this attack is proportionate to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target under the Irresistible effect cannot resist any types of harmful effects.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Gains immunity against Attack Bar reduction effects and increases the Attack Bar of all allies by 30% whenever an ally's cooldown increases. In addition, at the start of your turn, decreases the skill cooldown of the ally with the highest Attack Bar (excluding yourself) by 1 turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Immune to Attack Bar decreasing effects
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: Whenever an ally's skill cooldown increases.

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: Of the ally, excluding yourself, with the highest Attack Bar
